name: TEXAS 88
description: Texas 88 is a six-player version of Texas 42 using two double-six sets. Two teams of three, alternating seats. Each gets 9 tiles; 2 in kitty. Bid from 60 in steps of 2 up to 88 (or 176, 264, 352). High bidder may exchange with kitty. Follow suit; count tiles (5 or 10 pips) and 2 per trick = 88 points per round. First to 500 (or 7 marks) wins. No Nel-O, Plunge, or Forced Bidding.
